description: Publish the store's audit log, as the partition root.
rationale: publish_via_partition_root is the point of this specification. Without it the LEAF partitions replicate under their own names and the audit database would need a partition of each matching name -- which defeats a subscriber whose whole job is to keep everything the publisher rotates away. publish is insert only: an audit log is append-only, and sending updates or deletes would let a mistake on the store erase history on the audit side.
